mutationTargets.behavior: Garmin availability for a user is decided solely by that user's own stored connection, so a user stays connected when the global credential env pair is unset and disconnected when only another user is connected.

cleanupMappings.reason: The three environment-gated cases were rewritten in place rather than dropped: GarminAdapter.isConfigured became per-user truth, so assertions that it also required GARMIN_EMAIL/GARMIN_PASSWORD were replaced by assertions that only the per-user connection decides. The sibling isGarminConfiguredForUser in src/services/garmin.ts underwent a structurally identical edit but is a different symbol, is not governed by this mapping, and is mocked out of this test.
